card.name: Start of a unit after a number
card.fires_on: The first piece of a measurement unit written right after a number, such as km, mm, μ or m, before the unit is finished (km2, mm Hg, μm, mEq/L).

modes.label: Metric length units
modes.description: Unit like km, m or μ directly after a number, in areas, ranges or filter sizes.

modes.label: Clinical lab units
modes.description: Start of mm Hg, μL or mEq/L after a lab value or threshold.
modes.example: pH >7.60 or a pCO2 <20<< mm>> Hg is undesirable.

card.writes: It favors unit endings and slash-unit continuations such as /kg, /min and .ft, which suggests it prepares the rest of a measurement unit.
card.plain: It fires on the first letters of a unit like km, mm or μ right after a number.
